acceptance.draws: eight common seed18001+class and eight fresh seed audit_seed+step+100000+class; quantitative gate on combined16, record separate halves and require visual recognizability and structural variation on fresh draws
acceptance.memorization: flag near optimization copies; nearest pixel distance is no proof of absence; median novelty gate plus visual neighbor review
acceptance.persistence: same >=114 class intersection in both raw and EMA at two consecutive scheduled audits; confirm at identical two assessment points with independent training/audit seeds
acceptance.saturation: Report unclamped range and saturation; clipped-only apparent variation does not qualify
acceptance.visual: Per class >=6/8 recognizable in each half and >=3 distinct pose/shape/composition variants across16, neither texture/color/translation-only nor near copies. Record uncertain as inconclusive/fail. All151 reviewed for acceptance.

early_stop: After OT decay ends, two consecutive scheduled audits with <=15/151 quantitative-pass classes in BOTH raw and EMA, AND visual review across >=30 classes showing persistent templates or noise-only variation: stop for persistent collapse/nonstructural diversity. Incomplete but improving or ambiguous results continue to full horizon. No stop at first6k audit.
failure_stop: Numerical/resource failure immediately; at most2 exact infrastructure recoveries per candidate within original watchdog. User stop terminal.
